sentences.text:
Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
Bench: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition Nos. 5398, 5401 and
 5403 Of 2020
Common Order:

-
These petitions are filed under Section 482 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, seeking quash of charge sheets in C.C.No.875 of 2017 on the file of the learned II Addl. Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Kavali, SPSR Nellore District, C.C. No.571 of 2018 on the file of the learned II Addl. Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Kavali, SPSR Nellore District and C.C.No.67 of 2020 on the file of the learned I Additional Junior Civil Judge, Badvel, YSR Kadapa District.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
3. The petitioners have been facing prosecution for the offences punishable under Section 353 IPC and Section 58 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short "FSS Act") in Criminal Petition No.5398 of 2020 and Criminal Petition No.5401 of 2020; Sections 188, 270, 273 IPC,
Section 27 of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 (for short "COTP Act") and under Section 5(1) of the FSS Act in Criminal Petition No.5403 of 2020.

entities.text: Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that these are covered matters and as per earlier orders passed by this Court, F.I.Rs registered for the similar offences based on identical facts were quashed by this Court.
Therefore, they would pray for quash of the aforesaid charge sheets in the present petitions.
5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor would also fairly concede that these are covered matters in view of the earlier orders passed by this Court.
Therefore, he would pray to pass appropriate orders accordingly.

6. As can be seen from the common order passed by this court in Criminal Petition No.1432 of 2020 and batch, this Court based on the earlier orders passed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch and Criminal Petition No.222 of 2020, quashed several F.I.Rs registered for the Viswandhuni Raghu Kumar, vs State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 25 November, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6359726/
1 similar offences based on identical facts.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, the petitioners, who are similarly placed, are also entitled for quash of the charge sheets registered against them.

7. In the result, in view of the aforesaid orders of this Court and for the reasons stated therein, the Criminal Petitions are allowed and the charge sheets in C.C.No.875 of 2017 on the file of the learned II Addl. Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Kavali, SPSR Nellore District, C.C. No.571 of 2018 on the file of the learned II Addl. Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Kavali, SPSR Nellore District and C.C.No.67 of 2020 on the file of the learned I Additional Junior Civil Judge, Badvel, YSR Kadapa District, are hereby quashed.
Miscellaneous Petitions, if any pending, in the Criminal Petitions, shall stand closed.
